latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of text-to-easy skill.

- Instantly convert text, TXT, DOCX, or PDF up to 500MB into 1080p MP4 videos using cloud GPUs.
- Easy-to-use chat workflow for marketers, educators, and content creators — just upload and describe your desired video.
- Supports file upload, video generation, timeline editing, credits check, and instant export/download.
- Built-in anonymous authentication and session management; 100 free render credits for new users.
- Handles a wide range of formats: mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac.
- Clear, friendly guidance and robust error handling for upload, processing, credits, and exports.
